description: 2-in-1 Cordless & Corded Design: Use it anywhere with complete flexibility — operate wirelessly using the inbuilt rechargeable battery or plug it into your car’s 12 V socket for uninterrupted power. Ideal for both home use and emergency roadside assistance. Powerful 150 PSI Inflation: Inflates tyres quickly and efficiently with up to 150 PSI pressure. Perfect for cars, bikes, bicycles, and sports gear. Comes with 4 interchangeable nozzles for multipurpose use and reliable performance every time. . 3×2000 mAh Rechargeable Batteries: Equipped with triple 2000 mAh lithium batteries for extended runtime and strong air output. Type-C fast charging ensures your inflator is ready whenever you need it, making it perfect for travel or daily maintenance. Auto Shut-Off for Safety: No need to monitor continuously — simply set your desired pressure, and the inflator stops automatically once it’s reached. Prevents over-inflation and ensures accurate, worry-free inflation every time. Smart Digital Display: Bright, easy-to-read LED display shows both real-time and preset pressure values in PSI, BAR, KPA, and Kg/cm². Offers complete clarity and control during every inflation session. Built-In LED Light + SOS Modes: Bright LED torch enables night-time use and two emergency SOS flash modes provide added safety during breakdowns or low-light conditions — helping you stay visible and secure anywhere. Extended Reach & Compact Build: Features a 3-metre power cord to reach all tyres without moving your car. Compact, lightweight, and easy to store in your glove box or boot — designed for effortless portability.
